description: 🎨 Daron Mouradian is an Armenian painter born in 1961 in Yerevan. His fantastical and surreal artworks blend Eastern and Western influences, drawing deeply from Armenian culture, medieval imagery, mythology, and the Bible. Known for his intricate detail and ironic storytelling, Mouradian creates dreamlike worlds where knights ride cannonballs and fairy tales meet social critique.
